title: A real interface rebuild
notes: Redesigned: Today now has an iOS-style overview grid plus focused Today, Next, and Suggestions sections instead of a recoloured dashboard.
Redesigned: The app now uses a standard edge-to-edge tab bar, compact segmented task filters, grouped utility lists, large titles, and flatter surfaces.
Cloud: Google sign-in is live in the separate foxlabs-homework-planner Firebase project with isolated per-account storage.
Cloud safety: Explicit copy selection, revision checks, launch sync, conflict blocking, and final sign-out sync protect planner data.
Privacy: Homework Planner remains fully usable offline, never mixes accounts, blocks unauthenticated cloud reads, and keeps photos on the device.
